asbuilt_documented_state: a-d supports/foundations and the G1 external terrace context are documented in the as-built/current evidence set.
historical_model_claim: a-d/terrace participation is reported omitted from the original calculation model.
symbolic_delta_rule: Delta_G1terrace = Effect_asbuilt(documented supported terrace + a-d subsystem) - Effect_historical(source-proven model); evaluate only after both terms are traceable.
required_evidence: Direct historical frame/load-model evidence plus terrace structural-area/load-path classification.
model_rule: Preserve Model A historical and Model B documented/as-built separately; never delete a-d from Model B to reproduce Model A.
note: Built presence is DOC; historical omission remains RIF until direct calculation evidence appears.

asbuilt_documented_state: Shaped projecting balcony geometry is directly documented around the typical apartment wings.
historical_model_claim: Balcony effects are reported omitted from original calculations.
symbolic_delta_rule: Delta_balcony = Effect_asbuilt(documented balcony geometry and later evidenced loads) - Effect_historical(source-proven balcony treatment).
required_evidence: Level-by-level structural binding and loads plus original frame/load input sufficient to establish historical treatment.
model_rule: Do not infer historical omission from absence of a dedicated slab detail on the reinforcement sheet.
note: Architectural presence and historical treatment are different claims.

asbuilt_documented_state: Three top terrace wings and eight structural roof-beam overhang ends are documented; exact overhang length and terrace tributary binding remain open.
historical_model_claim: Added/shifted top configuration and related loads are reported not considered historically.
symbolic_delta_rule: Delta_top = Effect_asbuilt(top terrace zones + proven eave/roof/perimeter loads) - Effect_historical(source-proven top configuration).
required_evidence: Exact eave geometry/tributary zones and original top-level frame/load input.
model_rule: The eight DOC overhang ends may be modeled as current structural objects once geometry is complete, but historical omission must remain conditional.
note: The user-qualified 1.50 m overhang is not a DOC dimension.

asbuilt_documented_state: Current top architectural context is documented; causal outward displacement of the infill line is reported but not directly cross-registered.
historical_model_claim: The shifted infill effect is reported not considered in original calculations.
symbolic_delta_rule: Delta_infill = Effect(current confirmed infill line, weight, mass, eccentricity) - Effect(historical source-proven infill line/treatment).
required_evidence: Direct current-vs-historical infill-line comparison, wall build-up, and historical load input.
model_rule: Do not create an eccentric line load or seismic mass delta before geometric shift and historical reference line are both evidenced.

asbuilt_documented_state: Stair/core/torrino context is directly documented as a dedicated special subsystem; exact member footprint/load tributaries are open.
historical_model_claim: Historical load/model treatment is to verify.
symbolic_delta_rule: Delta_stair = Effect_asbuilt(bound stair/tower subsystem) - Effect_historical(source-proven stair/tower treatment).
required_evidence: Bound 3D stair/tower geometry, construction layers and historical model/load evidence.
model_rule: No historical omission is assumed; create a numerical delta only if the two traceable models differ.
note: This row prevents an OPEN historical audit from being misread as an omission.

asbuilt_documented_state: Raised PT fill/floor geometry is documented; inert fill, concrete pour and screeds are reported but thicknesses, unit weights and structural transfer remain ND.
historical_model_claim: Historical structural load treatment is not directly registered.
symbolic_delta_rule: Delta_PT = Effect_current(structurally transferred evidenced PT layers only) - Effect_historical(source-proven PT treatment).
required_evidence: PT stratigraphy/load path and historical load treatment.
model_rule: Ground-supported mass/load must remain distinct from gravity load transferred to frame/foundation; no delta is assigned from the full fill package by default.
note: Current repository source search for numeric PT build-up is closed until new evidence enters.
